notes: Resource count measures distinct learning sources, not videos, datasets, models, courses, or lessons contained within a source.
A public URL, open-access article, dataset card, or metadata record does not establish permission to download, redistribute, retain, or train.
FreeCodeCamp software code license does not automatically license every curriculum asset or third-party media.
YouTube captions.list returns track metadata, not caption text. captions.download requires OAuth and permission to edit the video; never bypass this restriction.
Tolkien works remain copyright-controlled. Study scholarly metadata, abstracts, authorized resources and licensed materials; do not bulk-copy novels, appendices, maps, audio, or proprietary lexicons.
Tolkien Gateway, LotR Project and Encyclopedia of Arda are secondary reference aids, not authoritative canon.
Verify every URL, current availability, license, publisher, date, update cadence and terms during source admission.
